query:
SELECT id, code, name, city FROM lines
            WHERE
                (
                    code ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
                    OR TO_TSVECTOR( name ) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('' || $1 || ':*')
                )
                AND city = $2
            GROUP BY
                code, name, city, id
            ORDER BY
                code
            LIMIT 40
